purpose: Independent response-only exercises of three revised skills; nine cases in three fresh actor sessions.

protocol.comparison: No original-skill or no-skill control; no measured improvement claim.
limitations: Known teaching cases selected after review, not held-out examples.
These assess written decisions, not generated applications, production security, database guarantees, or automatic skill selection.

cases.input: Fake gateway stores mutable Order references; port explicitly requires save. Use case loads, submits, never saves; another read appears submitted. What does the passing test establish and what focused changes/checks help?
cases.expected: Identify alias-induced false green; detached snapshots/deep ownership for explicit-save contract; prove missing-save test fails before repair.
cases.observed: Actor identified shared-reference visibility, proposed detached snapshots on reads/writes, checking unsaved mutations and making the missing-save test fail before adding save.

cases.input: Same operation, but port explicitly provides managed objects inside a Unit of Work; commit persists and rollback discards changes.
cases.expected: Preserve valid no-save contract; separate working/committed state and test commit/rollback across units of work.
cases.observed: Actor accepted no-save behavior under this contract, distinguished in-unit visibility from completion, and required commit/rollback evidence and real integration for actual persistence.

cases.input: Transaction-managed use case mutates managed Order, catches validation failure and returns Either.left. Policy does not recognize Either failures; no escaping exception or rollback request. Pure test asserts Left; database execution unavailable.
cases.expected: Flag managed-state commit risk; preserve result API; propose actual entry and independent durable read without claiming execution.
cases.observed: Actor identified normal-return commit eligibility, proposed failure-atomic mutation or explicit rollback coordination, and described a future real transaction test with independent reload and positive control. No tests claimed.

cases.input: GET /reports/42 allows user alice. Trusted verifier validates issuer, audience, time, signature, and issuer-controlled principal_kind. Token sub=alice, client_id=report-ui, principal_kind=user. Cache key=(iss,sub,resource,action).
cases.expected: Permit under stipulated user policy; identify cache key missing principal kind and relevant decision context.
cases.observed: Actor permitted the stipulated user while requiring trusted kind/namespace in identity, authorization and cache decisions.

cases.input: Same request and claims as A, changing only trusted principal_kind to client.
cases.expected: Deny user-only privilege for client alice; distinguish cold-cache bad user lookup and warm-cache permit reuse; exercise signed colliding tokens.
cases.observed: Actor denied client access, identified both lookup and cache paths, and proposed cold/warm and ordering checks with correctly signed tokens rather than tampered payloads.

cases.input: API accepts user and client-credentials grants, but samples show only iss/sub/aud/client_id/times and no trusted namespace/principal-kind contract. Team asserts signature plus matching alice user row is enough.
cases.expected: Identify missing trusted issuance semantics; do not infer user from client_id or invent a standard claim; avoid claiming demonstrated exploit.
cases.observed: Actor requested authoritative issuer/namespace evidence, rejected matching-row inference, kept user access denied pending evidence, and distinguished an unjustified assumption from a proven issuable collision.

cases.input: Admission envelope at most 12*t+10 risky operations in any t-second window, 30 prior in-flight operations, fault-to-effective-stop bound70s including margin; allowance600 affected operations. All other gates satisfied.
cases.expected: Compute880 and reject current exposure; reduce admission or bounded containment time.
cases.observed: Actor computed880, rejected exposure, and derived alternatives <=8 operations/s or containment <=46 2/3 seconds under unchanged assumptions.

cases.input: Same conditions as A, changing only fault-to-stop bound to35s.
cases.expected: Compute460; permit stated first step with supplied bounds, preserving later promotion checks.
cases.observed: Actor computed460, allowed the first step under stated conditions, and retained independent later promotion/budget checks.

cases.input: Promotion applies a fixed-sample significance test at12predeclared five-minute windows and promotes at first pass. Does predeclaring times preserve nominal error guarantee? Confirmed duplicate payments may occur meanwhile.
cases.expected: Reject repeated-look guarantee without suitable error control; contain confirmed severe harm immediately.
cases.observed: Actor required one final analysis or repeated-look control and called for immediate containment rather than waiting for significance.
